description: Depuratori della Regione Emilia-Romagna - edizione 2021 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizi-gis.arpae.it. Localisation of urban wastewater treatment plants in the Emilia-Romagna Region - 2020 update - 2021 edition. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Depurators of the Emilia-Romagna Region - 2021 edition" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2020-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
